name: Djed Stablecoin
oneLiner: DJED is COTI's overcollateralized Cardano dollar stablecoin, minted against ADA reserves while SHEN holders absorb reserve volatility within a target band.
collateral: ADA reserves held by the Cardano Djed protocol, with SHEN reserve-coin holders absorbing surplus reserve volatility
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized Cardano stablecoin where DJED can be minted and burned against ADA while SHEN maintains the reserve ratio band

oracleRisk.summary: Djed uses one shared ADA reserve contract and an external pricing index for system-wide mint and redemption accounting; the reviewed primary sources do not identify the production oracle provider or failure handling.

branchApplicability.rationale: Djed is an autonomous reserve contract that mints and burns DJED and the SHEN reserve coin against one shared base-coin reserve. Users do not open borrower-specific collateral positions, and the reviewed design exposes no market-specific oracle or liquidation branches.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Djed is a Cardano native asset. Cardano's native-token model routes ordinary transfers through the ledger rather than an ERC-20-style token contract; the minting policy controls mint and burn operations, not arbitrary holder transfers. The official Djed documentation and technical review describe the ADA reserve, DJED mint/burn, and SHEN mechanisms without a holder blacklist or freeze path. Direct holder-balance blacklistability remains false.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: SONG-5 Safety Score V9 access review

mintAuthority.summary: DJED is minted and burned permissionlessly against a shared ADA reserve pool by a formally verified autonomous smart-contract bank, with SHEN reserve-coin holders absorbing volatility; minting is gated by the 400%-800% reserve-ratio band rather than a per-user CDP, and COTI/IOG operate the oracle. The minting policy (Plutus V1) is immutable on Cardano — the reserve-ratio enforcement cannot be bypassed; COTI only controls the oracle price feed.

controls.label: Djed autonomous bank contract (reserve mint/burn)
controls.capDescription: DJED mint allowed only while the ADA reserve ratio stays at or above 400% (and within the 400%-800% band); mint price set by oracle ADA/USD.
controls.evidence: Koios script_info confirms the DJED minting policy (hash 8db269c3ec630e06ae29f74bc39edd1f87c819f1056206e879a1cd61) is type plutusV1, created in tx 46c1db4ab4cae757880056fc4f48abb313bccec71b3f8fff9f10c6749b819ead. Plutus V1 scripts are immutable on Cardano — the reserve-ratio logic (400%-800% band) is hardcoded and cannot be changed. No upgrade mechanism exists for Plutus V1 minting policies.

controls.label: COTI / IOG operator (oracle price feed only)
controls.evidence: COTI controls the ADA/USD oracle price NFT used by the Djed Plutus script. The oracle can only update the price feed — it cannot bypass the immutable reserve-ratio enforcement in the Plutus V1 script. The upgrade path is absent (Plutus V1 scripts cannot be upgraded on Cardano).

review.evidence: Koios API confirmed the DJED minting policy (8db269c3ec630e06ae29f74bc39edd1f87c819f1056206e879a1cd61) is a Plutus V1 smart contract — immutable, created at genesis tx. The reserve-ratio enforcement (400%-800% band) is encoded in the script and cannot be overridden or upgraded. COTI's administrative surface is limited to the off-chain oracle price feed; it cannot bypass or change the Plutus V1 mint rules. No upgrade path exists for Cardano Plutus V1 minting policies.

reserveReview.rationale: Current COTI and IOG materials identify ADA as DJED's exogenous reserve and SHEN as the reserve coin; the 400%-800% band governs mint and burn. The reviewed public materials do not provide a current reconciled ADA balance or detailed operational custody account information, so the reserve remains one fixed ADA envelope.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-2 (lead buidl-blackrock)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Reserves are ADA locked at a dedicated Cardano script address with no custodian; the pool balance (about 28.99M ADA on 2026-07-19) is independently verifiable on-chain. COTI has not officially published the contract addresses — the inventory comes from the community-maintained open-djed registry — and the pre-launch audit COTI announced was never published with an auditor name or report. Legal bankruptcy-remoteness and rehypothecation terms do not apply to script custody; the reserve is delegated (staked) but not lent out.
